_meta.description: TrueValue Analytics site index — single source of truth for all hub navigation. Edit this file to add, remove, or reorder entries; the hub pages fetch and render from it automatically.

projects.title: Photosynthesis
projects.desc: C3 photosynthesis energy flow chain: 8 phases from photon capture to carbon export, with ecological output chain (carbon, O2, biomass, sequestration, stress responses). Tholonic N-D-C analysis. Bottleneck: Rubisco at Phase 5.
projects.tag: Photosynthesis — C3 Energy Flow and Ecological Output Hub

projects.title: Cellular Aging
projects.desc: 8-phase N-D-C analysis of the mammalian cellular maintenance and replication chain. Phases 0-4 are Coherent (91-96%); Phase 3 quality control failure (79%) propagates through epigenetic drift (Ph 5, 76%) to senescent cell accumulation (Ph 6, 72% — primary bottleneck). Countermeasures tiered T1 (human RCT) through T5 (traditional and cultural practice). Return chain TVPCI-R = 58.7 (Failure), B_chain = 53.9.
projects.tag: Cellular Aging — Supply Chain, Degradation, and Intervention Hub

projects.title: Danube Basin
projects.desc: Danube Basin ecosystem services: 19 countries, 81 million people, 801,463 km². Paired natural and human service chains — pilot with natural freshwater availability and human freshwater supply infrastructure.
projects.tag: Danube Basin — Ecosystem Services Hub (Pilot)

projects.title: Gold
projects.desc: Supply chain, system lifecycle, and value chain models for gold, from geological occurrence through refining, fabrication, custody, exchange registration, and recycling.
projects.tag: Gold - Supply, Lifecycle & Value Chain Hub

projects.title: Burkina Faso Shea
projects.desc: Dual-scenario N-D-C analysis of the Burkina Faso shea butter supply chain: BAU (traditional fuelwood processing) vs. Serious Shea (eco-processing centres). 8 phases, AfDB/World Bank backed, 6,000+ women producers, 95% GHG reduction pathway.
projects.tag: Burkina Faso Shea — BAU vs. Serious Shea Supply Chain Hub

projects.title: West African Shea
projects.desc: Supply chain, system lifecycle, and value chain models for shea butter, from Burkina Faso / West Africa to end market, with SDG impact framework.
projects.tag: West African Shea - Supply, Lifecycle & Value Chain Hub

projects.title: Lighter
projects.desc: Supply chain, system lifecycle, and value chain models for the disposable plastic lighter. 10 billion units per year; 30+ precision components; $0.12 factory gate FOB. The canonical TVPCI example of micro-margin optimization — where brand abstraction (BIC premium: $0.60/unit) is the only available rent in an otherwise fully price-compressed supply chain.
projects.tag: Lighter - Supply, Lifecycle & Value Chain Hub

projects.title: Marina Alta Ecosystem
projects.desc: Multi-commodity climate adaptation ecosystem in the Alicante Mountains, Spain. Anchor: Cerezas de la Montana de Alicante PGI (cherry collapse 94%, 2026 recovery). Plus premium EVOO (Flos Olei), almonds (Xylella crisis), and replacement crops (pistachios, carob). 8 phases from aquifer baseline to ecosystem regeneration. EU Horizon EUR 83M Climate Adaptation funding target.
projects.tag: Marina Alta Mountain Ecosystem — Multi-Commodity Climate Adaptation Hub

projects.title: Spain Olive Oil
projects.desc: Spanish olive oil supply and value chain: 8 phases from Andalusian groves through international trade. Spain produces ~51% of global output (2.5M ha, 340M trees) but captures only EUR 3.22/kg vs Italy's EUR 4.42/kg because ~67% of exports leave as bulk. Phase 5 bottleneck (81.1%): EUR 1.20/kg brand premium Spain foregoes to Italian repackagers. Record EUR 6B export revenues in 2023/24.
projects.tag: Olive Oil — Supply & Value Chain Hub

projects.title: Cocoa International
projects.desc: Global cocoa supply and value chain: 7 phases from West African smallholder farms through manufacturing and retail. Ivory Coast 44% and Ghana 16% of global supply (~5M farms, avg 2 ha). Primary bottleneck Phase 1 (Fermentation/Drying, 76.5%): the most critical flavor-defining transformation occurs with no chain-of-custody documentation, rendering all downstream sustainability certifications structurally unverifiable. TVPCI-R: 46.0 (failure zone). Ivory Coast origin-processing shift (35% domestic grinding) is restructuring global value distribution.
projects.tag: Cocoa International — Global Supply & Value Chain Hub

projects.title: Cocoa Netherlands
projects.desc: Netherlands cocoa industrial processing hub: 6 phases from port arrival (Rotterdam/Amsterdam, 1.2M t/year) through EU re-export. World-class data quality H throughout — anchored by Port of Rotterdam Authority, IDH Dutch Sustainability Agreement (75% market coverage), NVWA, ECA, and major processor annual reports. Phase 3 (CBE Manufacturing) is a documented composite integrating TrueValue shea Phase 4 Export values at 5% weight, reflecting IOI Loders Croklaan Wormerveer operations under EU Chocolate Directive 2000/36/EC. Bottleneck Phase 4 (Dutch Manufacturing, 85.1%, Fair zone) — structural gap between Tony's Chocolonely Living Income model and conventional CBE-using manufacturers. TVPCI-R: 65.0 (vs 46.0 global).
projects.tag: Cocoa Netherlands — Industrial Processing and Value Hub

projects.title: Bristol One City
projects.desc: 7-phase N-D-C analysis of Bristol's One City Plan urban delivery chain: from political mandate through governance, capital deployment, and infrastructure delivery to measurable city-wide outcomes. Chain balance 81.3% (Good zone); bottleneck Phase 5 Community Uptake (58.3%, Poor). TVPCI-R = 50.7 (Failure: community wealth return not reaching deprived wards). B_chain = 47.0. Municipal sustainability-linked bond opportunity: Bristol has £1bn+ City Leap JV and robust monitoring (256 QoL indicators, PHOF, BACCC) but has raised only £2m through citizen investment. e-axis score 52.0: no institutional SLB yet structured.
projects.tag: Bristol One City — Urban Delivery Chain and Municipal SLB Hub

projects.title: Gran Chaco
projects.desc: Gran Chaco soy, beef, and forest ecosystem services: 65 Mha dry forest under deforestation pressure from soy and cattle expansion. Five-phase soy supply chain from land conversion through EUDR export compliance. Bond focus: sustainability-linked instruments tied to deforestation-free sourcing KPIs. Phase 2 bottleneck (62.9%) is the binding constraint for deforestation-free certification.
projects.tag: Gran Chaco — Soy, Beef & Forest Ecosystem Services Hub

projects.title: Senegal Agroforestry
projects.desc: Senegal agroforestry and ecosystem carbon chain: 8 phases from in-situ origin through market delivery. Three complementary chains: livelihoods (moringa, shea, mango, groundnut), ecosystem recovery (biogas/biochar recycling), and carbon/nature credits (Acorn/EP Carbon/Mirova). System balance 78%. One of 12 winners, Trillion Trees: Sahel and Great Green Wall Challenge 2021 (Clarity Coalition, WEF). TVPCI-R: 60.7 (return chain lags forward chain by 17.3 points — Phase 4 processing opacity is the primary bottleneck). Mirova carbon projection: 96,116 tCO₂ / $9.9M over 30 years (mid scenario).
projects.tag: Senegal Agroforestry — Ecosystem Carbon and Agroforestry Hub

projects.title: AUBEB
projects.desc: Africa Union Blue Economy Bond: supply chain, system lifecycle, and value chain models for 150,000 ha coastal mangrove restoration across 7 AU member states.
projects.tag: Mangrove - Supply, Lifecycle & Value Chain Hub

projects.title: Blue Carbon
projects.desc: Preliminary cTVF gap-analysis workspace for blue carbon, blue finance, blended finance, ecosystem-service value, coastal community market access, and investor-readiness questions. Current data is limited and not sufficient for final scoring.
projects.tag: Blue Carbon - Preliminary Gap Analysis

projects.title: Singapore NEWater
projects.desc: Full 12-phase water cycle — PUB single-actor model. From catchment abstraction to NEWater advanced treatment and reservoir loop closure. Tholonic benchmark for institutional coherence.
projects.tag: Water Recycling – Singapore PUB NEWater

projects.title: Orange County GWRS
projects.desc: Full 12-phase water cycle — OC San + OCWD + 30 municipal agencies. Groundwater Replenishment System, Fountain Valley, CA. Tholonic contrast case: fragmented institutional model.
projects.tag: Water Recycling – Orange County GWRS

projects.title: Jackson MS Water
projects.desc: Broken-system case study for Jackson, Mississippi municipal water: treatment reliability, distribution pressure, household delivery, emergency repair, and maintenance lifecycle failure.
projects.tag: Broken System - Municipal Water

projects.title: Silicon Valley Bank
projects.desc: Bank structural failure case study: N-D-C analysis of Silicon Valley Bank using public FDIC Call Report data. Phase 3 (Interest Rate Risk) entered Breakdown in Q3 2021 and remained there 6 quarters before the March 2023 failure. Standard regulatory metrics showed green throughout. Chain balance 61.3%, bottleneck phases 2, 3, 4, 6. Includes intervention worksheet, FDIC resolution recovery analysis, and peer screening framework.
projects.tag: Bank Failure Analysis - Financial Institutions

projects.title: Lehman Brothers
projects.desc: Bank structural failure case study: N-D-C analysis of Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc. using public SEC filings and the Valukas Examiner Report. Phase 3 (Leverage and Risk Management) entered Breakdown in Q1 2007 and remained there 8 quarters before the September 2008 failure. 6 of 8 phases below the coherence floor. Chain balance 49.9% : the largest bankruptcy filing in US history. Includes Repo 105 deception analysis, intervention worksheet, Chapter 11 resolution recovery, and comparison with SVB.
projects.tag: Bank Failure Analysis - Financial Institutions

projects.title: ERCOT Winter Storm Uri
projects.desc: Broken-system case study for the Texas ERCOT grid during Winter Storm Uri: fuel dependency, generation outages, balancing, load shedding, restoration, and winterization lifecycle failure.
projects.tag: Broken System - Electrical Grid

projects.title: History of Economic Thought
projects.desc: Tholonic N-D-C model applied to the intellectual supply chain of economics: 10 paradigm epochs from pre-3000 BCE to present. Each epoch analyzed for D (constraints), C (outputs), and N (emergent intellectual equilibrium). Chain avg balance 81.1%. Phase 9 (Post-Crisis Fragmentation) is the current bottleneck at 74%.
projects.tag: History of Economic Thought — Tholonic Paradigm Chain

projects.title: Tholonic Neural Architecture
projects.desc: Three subprojects applying the tholonic N-D-C framework to neural networks: (1) interactive visualization of inference as a progressive entropy-reducing supply chain across scopes, (2) empirical φ-ratio measurement in GPT-2 (no training required), (3) training experiment with the tholonic balance regularizer. Based on Milton (2026).
projects.tag: Tholonic Neural Architecture — AI Research Hub

projects.title: Water Recycling Comparison
projects.desc: NEWater vs. OCWD GWRS — same technology, 42% cost gap. Tholonic N-D-C analysis reveals institutional overhead as the source. TVPCI derivation: USD 0.37/m³ institutional efficiency premium.
projects.tag: Tholonic Comparative Analysis – NEWater vs. OCWD

projects.title: Marina Alta vs. Andalucia
projects.desc: Marina Alta mountain ecosystem (Alicante) vs. Andalucia olive monoculture — same climate stress, crossing failure curves. Marina Alta bottleneck at Phase 2 (harvest, 76.5%) and Phase 6 (crop transition, 75.0%). Andalucia bottleneck at Phase 0 (soil biology, 65.4%) and Phase 5 (bulk export value gap, 65.3%). System balances 86.3% vs 75.9%. Different diagnoses, different primary interventions.
projects.tag: Tholonic Comparative Analysis – Marina Alta vs. Andalucia Olive Ecosystem

items.title: Tholonic N-D-C Structure and Its Philosophical Predecessors: Spinoza and Leibniz

Spinoza captures the dynamic process dimension; Leibniz captures the structural unit dimension. The tholonic model provides the formal mathematical unification neither philosopher achieved.

items.title: Elinor Ostrom's Design Principles and the Tholonic N-D-C Framework: Governance as Structural Balance
items.desc: Ostrom's eight CPR design principles divide into D-type constraints and C-type participatory mechanisms. The tragedy of the commons is a C-dominant partial tholon; top-down regulatory collapse is D-dominant. The tholonic balance score B extends Ostrom's binary principle-presence assessment to a continuous governance health metric.

items.title: Gold V2 — Threshold-Ratio Normalized

items.title: Gold V3 — Complex Number Extension
items.desc: Extends gold_v2 by representing each phase as z = D + iC. The argument θ = arctan(C/D) encodes the balance angle and the modulus |z| = √(D²+C²) captures total operational load invisible to the balance score alone. Implements Section 11 of the N-D-C measurement framework.
